correctness.rationale: All central trinomial T_n are odd because T_n=Σ_j binom(n,2j)binom(2j,j) and binom(2j,j) is even for j≥1. Let P(x)=x^-1+1+x. Coefficientwise Frobenius P^{2^s}≡P(x^{2^s}) mod2 plus repeated squaring yields P^{2^r}≡P(x^{2^s})^{2^{r−s}} mod2^{r−s+1}. Choosing s=r−k+1 (r≥k) makes all nonzero exponents of size less than 2^s vanish mod 2^k and gives T_{2^r+m}≡T_{2^r}T_m mod2^k for 0≤m<2^s. Taking s=1 gives T_{2^r}≡T_{2^{r−1}} mod2^r; hence L=lim_r T_{2^r}∈Z₂ exists and L≡T₄=19≡3 mod8. L mod2^k has order 2^{k−2} by LTE, covering the 1/3 mod8 odd classes; T₃=7 multiplies into the remaining 5/7 mod8 coset. Arbitrarily separated dyadic-index blocks realize T_b L^t mod2^k, b∈{0,3}, and can be varied infinitely while retaining the class. Independent recurrence computations reproduced all odd residue images modulo 2^k for k≤8 and bounded block congruences; these are diagnostics. The arbitrary-k proof is constructive.

None of the inspected complete relevant statements contains the separated-block product realization and full all-level odd-class surjectivity.
